caption: Contributing Finding
description: The Contributing Finding object describes the current and projected state of an individual finding that is affected by a remediation target, including severity and trait changes.
name: contributing_finding

severity.description: The severity of the finding in its current state, normalized to the caption of the severity_id value.

severity_id.description: The normalized severity identifier of the finding in its current state.

traits.description: The security traits associated with the finding in its current state.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the finding.

updated_severity.description: The projected severity of the finding after remediation, normalized to the caption of the updated_severity_id value.

updated_severity_id.description: The projected normalized severity identifier of the finding after remediation.

updated_traits.description: The projected security traits that will remain on the finding after remediation.
